cross_check.method:
One direct HTTPS GET of the official portal HTML for this section (raw_html_sha256 and response_bytes pinned in source) and one GET of its print/PDF render (entityprint/pdf/node redirects to print/pdf/node). The verbatim excerpt was extracted PROGRAMMATICALLY from the raw HTML (the field--name-body container): defined terms (bold-italic ) written #term#; one block per paragraph/list item in page order; a heading line and its following text (a double
in the HTML) are separate blocks; runs of whitespace and non-breaking spaces collapsed to one space and each block trimmed; embedded figures omitted. The print/PDF was converted to text (pdftotext -layout) and its body was compared word-for-word with the extracted excerpt (whitespace and hyphenated line-wraps normalised on both sides). The list-item LABELS in the excerpt are the labels this print/PDF prints in front of each item (the HTML renders them as CSS ordered-list markers with no label glyph in the page text).

verbatim_excerpt_composition: Verbatim blocks joined by a blank line, in page order: [0] the displayed section number and title; then each body paragraph and list item. A list item is written with the label the section's print/PDF render prints in front of it, followed by one space; a list item's heading line and its following text (a double line break in the HTML) are separate blocks, and only the heading (the first block of the item) carries the label. Defined terms (bold-italic in the HTML) are written #term#. Runs of whitespace and non-breaking spaces are written as one space and each block is trimmed; embedded figures are omitted; no word was changed. The list-item labels were confirmed against the print/PDF render (cross_check).
